content.text:
**Not found with these tools.** I couldn't get the share count for the maximum dilutive impact of Snap's convertible notes as of 12/31/2024, so I'm not giving a number.

**What I found:**
- Full-text search shows that Snap's FY2024 10-K (period ending 2024-12-31) talks about its convertible notes and their dilutive impact on share count. Snap's 10-Qs for Q3 2024 and Q1 2025 do too. So the figure is in the 10-K.
- The search tool only tells me which filings match. It doesn't return the text, so I couldn't read the number from the filing.
- I checked Snap's structured financial data (XBRL) under several likely labels: shares excluded from diluted EPS, number of shares the notes convert into, extra shares from converting debt, and a Snap-specific label. None of them exist in Snap's filings.
- I also pulled the full list of everything Snap reports in its XBRL data. It was too large to come back in one piece, and I ran out of my tool-call budget before I could search it.

**Where to look:** the 10-K below, in the Net Loss per Share note, where Snap lists the shares left out of diluted EPS, and in the Debt / Convertible Notes note. The number will likely be described as the maximum number of shares the notes could convert into, including any added for "make-whole" adjustments (extra shares owed if notes convert early around certain corporate events).

**Sources**
- Snap Inc. Form 10-K for FY2024, filed 2025-02-05, accession 0001564408-25-000019 (snap-20241231.htm). Found by search; I couldn't read the text.
- Snap Inc. Form 10-Q for Q1 2025, filed 2025-04-30, accession 0001564408-25-000030. Found by search; I couldn't read the text.
- Snap Inc. Form 10-Q for Q3 2024, filed 2024-10-30, accession 0001564408-24-000062. Found by search; I couldn't read the text.
